camel_example: aliyun bssopenapi DescribeInstanceBill --region cn-hangzhou --BillingCycle '2020-03' --NextToken CAESEgoQCg4KCm --ProductCode rds --IsHideZeroCharge false --InstanceID abc --MaxResults 20 --ProductType rds --BillOwnerId 122 --IsBillingItem false --BillingDate '2020-03-02' --Granularity MONTHLY --PipCode rds --SubscriptionType PayAsYouGo
description_en: Queries the consumption summary of all product instances or billable items for an account within a billing cycle
description_zh: 查询用户某个账期内所有商品实例或计费项的消费汇总
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi describe-instance-bill --billing-cycle 2020-03 --product-code rds --product-type rds --subscription-type PayAsYouGo --is-billing-item false --next-token CAESEgoQCg4KCm --max-results 20 --is-hide-zero-charge false --billing-date 2020-03-02 --granularity MONTHLY --bill-owner-id 122 --instance-id abc --pip-code rds --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstanceBill

parameters.help_en: The billing cycle in YYYY-MM format. Only billing cycles within the past 18 months are supported
parameters.help_zh: 账期YYYY－MM。仅支持最近18个月账期
parameters.name: billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type. Valid values:

Subscription: subscription

PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
订阅类型。取值：
Subscription：预付费。
PayAsYouGo：后付费
parameters.name: subscription_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to pull data by billing item dimension.

false (default): The data is consistent with the Instance Bill page under Expenses and Costs > Bills > Bill Details.

true: The data is consistent with the Billing Item Bill page under Expenses and Costs > Bills > Bill Details
parameters.help_zh:
是否按照计费项维度拉取数据。

false（默认值）：与费用与成本-费用账单-账单明细-实例账单一致。
true：与费用与成本-费用账单-账单明细-计费项账单一致
parameters.name: is_billing_item

parameters.help_en: The token that specifies the starting point for reading data. Leave this parameter empty to read the first page of results. To read the next page, set this parameter to the NextToken value that was returned in the previous response. Any other value will cause an error
parameters.help_zh: 用来表示当前调用开始读取的位置，参数值必须为空或者使用返回结果中的NextToken设值，否则会报错。空代表从头开始读取
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of data records to return. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量。默认值：20，最大值：300
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to exclude bills where both PretaxGrossAmount and PretaxAmount are 0.

false

true
parameters.help_zh:
根据原价（PretaxGrossAmount）和应付（PretaxAmount）是否都为0做过滤。取值：
false。
true
parameters.name: is_hide_zero_charge

parameters.help_en:
The bill date. This parameter is required only when Granularity is set to DAILY. The format is YYYY-MM-DD.

The month of BillingDate must match the month of BillingCycle. For example, if BillingCycle is 2020-03, BillingDate must be in the format 2020-03-DD. If the months do not match, the query returns results based on the BillingCycle setting
parameters.help_zh:
账单日期，仅当Granularity为DAILY时必填，格式为YYYY-MM-DD。

BillingDate参数值需和BillingCycle参数月份保持一致，例如BillingCycle设置为2020-03，BillingDate需设置为2020-03-DD。若月份设置不一致，查询的结果按BillingCycle设置的时间返回
parameters.name: billing_date

parameters.help_en:
The granularity of the bills to query. Valid values:

MONTHLY: Monthly. This corresponds to the bills on the Bills by Billing Cycle tab of the Bill Details page.

DAILY: Daily. This corresponds to the bills on the Bills by Day tab of the Bill Details page.

Specify BillingDate if you select DAILY
parameters.help_zh:
查询账单的颗粒度。取值如下：

MONTHLY：月。与费用与成本-费用账单-账单明细-账期账单一致。
DAILY：日。与费用与成本-费用账单-账单明细-按天账单一致。

选择DAILY需指定BillingDate
parameters.name: granularity

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource ownership account. This is the account that actually uses the resources
parameters.help_zh: 资源归属账号ID，资源归属账号是实际使用资源的账号
parameters.name: bill_owner_id

parameters.help_en: The product code. This is the same as the product code on the bill in the User Center
parameters.help_zh: 产品Code，与费用中心账单产品Code一致
parameters.name: pip_code

AfterDiscountAmount.description_en: The amount after a discount is applied. This amount includes the payable amount after coupon deductions. The formula is: Discounted amount = List price - Discount amount
AfterDiscountAmount.description_zh: 优惠后金额（包含券抵扣的应付金额数据。计算规则为：优惠后金额=官网目录价-优惠金额）

BillAccountID.description_en: The ID of the account to which the bill belongs

BillAccountName.description_en: The name of the account associated with the bill

BillingDate.description_en: The billing date is in YYYY-MM-DD format. This parameter has a value only when Granularity is set to DAILY
BillingDate.description_zh: 账单日期，仅当Granularity为DAILY时有值，格式为YYYY-MM-DD

BillingItem.description_en: The billing item. This property has a value only when IsBillingItem is true

CashAmount.description_zh: 现金支付（不包含信用额度退款抵扣）

CommodityCode.description_en: The product code. This is the same as the product detail code in the User Center
CommodityCode.description_zh: 商品Code，与费用中心产品明细Code一致

Currency.description_en:
The currency. Valid values:

CNY

USD

JPY
Currency.description_zh:
币种，取值：

CNY。
USD。
JPY

DeductedByResourcePackage.description_en: The amount deducted by the resource plan. This parameter is valid only when isBillingItem is true
DeductedByResourcePackage.description_zh: 资源包抵扣, 仅当isBillingItem为true时有效

InstanceConfig.description_en: The detailed configuration of the instance

Item.description_en:
The bill type:

SubscriptionOrder: A prepaid order.

PayAsYouGoBill: A postpaid bill.

Refund: A refund.

Adjustment: An adjustment
Item.description_zh:
账单类型：
SubscriptionOrder （预付订单）。
PayAsYouGoBill （后付账单）。
Refund （退款）。
Adjustment （调账）

ListPrice.description_en: The list price. This is valid only when isBillingItem is true
ListPrice.description_zh: 单价, 仅当isBillingItem为true时有效

ListPriceUnit.description_en: The unit of the list price. This parameter is valid only when isBillingItem is true
ListPriceUnit.description_zh: 单价单位, 仅当isBillingItem为true时有效

OwnerID.description_en: The Account ID of the resource owner in a multi-account payment scenario
OwnerID.description_zh: 资源Owner账号AccountID（多账号代付场景）

PaymentAmount.description_zh: 现金支付（含信用额度退款抵扣）

PipCode.description_en: The product code. It is the same as the product code on the bill in the User Center
PipCode.description_zh: 产品Code，与费用中心账单产品Code一致

ServicePeriodUnit.description_en: The unit of the service period

SubscriptionType.description_en:
The subscription type. Valid values:

Subscription: Subscription.

PayAsYouGo: Pay-as-you-go
SubscriptionType.description_zh:
订阅类型，取值：

Subscription：预付费。
PayAsYouGo：后付费

Usage.description_en:
The usage.

This parameter is valid only when isBillingItem is set to true. The usage data is the total usage from all bills in an epoch, not the actual purchased amount. For example, if you use 1 GB of storage and a bill is generated every hour, the hourly usage is 1 GB. The daily usage on the bill is 1 GB × 24 = 24 GB
Usage.description_zh:
用量。

仅当isBillingItem为true时有效。用量数据为该周期内所有账单的用量总和并非客户的实际购买量。如使用了1G的存储，每小时出账，则每小时用量为1G，按天汇总的账单用量为1G*24=24G

UsageUnit.description_en: The usage unit. This parameter is valid only when isBillingItem is true
UsageUnit.description_zh: 用量单位, 仅当isBillingItem为true时有效

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数

NextToken.description_en: The token that marks the position for the next query. An empty value indicates that all data has been read. To continue the query, set the NextToken request parameter to this value in your next call
NextToken.description_zh: 用来表示当前调用返回读取到的位置，空代表数据已经读取完毕。下次调用时，需要将此设置到入参NextToken中

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
